thread:
Ellen: Rapid kickoff  Need a one-pager + launch post for our Secure Deploy offering (VPC & on-prem). Audience: AEs + compliance leads. Must include SLA snapshot, inbound routing fields, benchmark headline, and webinar + workshop CTAs. Who can own?

Marco: Ill take the AE pocket guide and routing checklist. Will keep it to one page.

Priya: I'll pull the benchmark numbers and write a short two-sentence narrative. Use the quantized L2-13b CSV as source.

Derek: I'll build the HubSpot form and mapping. Proposed fields: `deployment_choice`, `compliance_needed`, `residency_region`, `priority_sla`.

FormBot: form created -> secure-deploy-interest-3987 ; utm_campaign=secure-deploy-q2 :white_check_mark:

Priya: Draft stat: "Dedicated shows ~2x sustained throughput and ~1.4x lower cost per token vs Hosted for long-running high-QPS workloads (quantized L2-13b)." Will footnote test harness and workload shape.

Legal: Avoid absolute uptime language. Use "SLA-backed" and link to legal terms. Compliance line approved: "Supports SOC2 and ISO-aligned controls; Private/on-prem options available for strict residency or regulatory needs."

Marco: AE cheat-sheet plan: 5-sentence pitch, 3 qualifying Qs, routing checklist (if `compliance_needed` contains HIPAA or `deployment_choice` == Private -> Enterprise AE queue; if `priority_sla` checked -> urgent tag + notify SEs).

Derek: Routing mapping done: form -> HubSpot -> AE queue mapping doc in Confluence. I'll also add hidden `campaign_tag` for MQL tracking.

Ellen: Webinar slots: Wed 9am PT or Thu 1pm PT. Field prefers Wed. Format: 25m demo + 20m workshop-style Q&A. CTA: "Schedule a secure deploy workshop" (calendar) + "Join webinar" RSVP.

Priya: I'll produce a small visual: two-column stat block (Latency p95, Cost per 1M tokens) Hosted vs Dedicated + short footnote.

Marco: I'll draft the AE one-pager and share by EOD tomorrow. Priya, please drop the exact table values in thread when available.

Derek: I'll pilot routing with two AEs next week and report back.

Ellen: Great. Recap: Marco = AE cheat-sheet + routing checklist, Priya = bench narrative + stat block, Derek = HubSpot form + routing mapping, Legal = compliance blurb. Review scheduled tomorrow 10:30am PT. Ping here if blocked. :rocket:
